Container.Name: Stache
Container.Overview: Self-hosted, photo-first home inventory. "Where is my stuff?" - snap a photo, drop the thing in a bin, scan the bin's QR label. No names required, no categories, no forms. Search by text, barcode, or photo; out/missing tracking; QR area labels; offline PWA; optional AI.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database + photos + AI model cache. Back up this folder.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone used by the digest schedule

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Session secret. Optional - auto-generated and persisted if left blank.

Config.Name: STACHE_NO_ML
Config.Description: Set to 1 to disable CLIP embeddings (very low-RAM hosts)
